scope: Original review phases 0–4; closure steps 1–5. Documentation alone never discharges a required criterion.

criteria.criterion: Reproduced trust defects have targeted positive and negative regressions

evidence.result: 77 tests passed on clean Linux Node 20.19.0 and 24.21.0 profiles, including original assertion/DOM and changed-input regressions
evidence.scope: Originally reproduced TS defects; not whole-language semantic certification

criteria.criterion: Repeated analysis is deterministic modulo declared timestamps and run identity

evidence.result: 24 pinned MyStarQuest observations: identical semantic hashes within each app/functions focused/audit profile across three cold/warm pairs; cache/order and meaningful-change negative controls pass
evidence.scope: Declared v2 semantic boundary, Linux Node 24.21/npm 12.1, MyStarQuest 9ceeb3f; no Git-base comparison, cross-platform equivalence, accuracy or resource-budget claim

criteria.criterion: Unresolved semantics cannot report fully evaluated evidence
criteria.reason: Missing typed prerequisites and producer-level capability states are repaired; exhaustive per-rule applicability and unresolved-semantics propagation remain pending. See trust-evidence-execution.md.

criteria.criterion: Complete native CI and declared integration profiles pass
criteria.reason: Clean Linux Node 20.19.0/npm 10.8.2 and Node 24.21.0/npm 12.1.0 CI/package smoke pass (77 tests). Windows remains unexecuted. Node 20 installation warns that jscpd's commander 15 requires Node >=22.12. Fresh npm audit reports five high advisories through jscpd. Nix build is blocked by an upstream TinyCC source hash mismatch. No floor/support or security waiver was made.

criteria.criterion: Run, capability, finding, measurement and comparison wire vocabulary has conformance fixtures and native validation

evidence.result: Shared capability and wire conformance fixtures passed at the native writer boundary
evidence.scope: Vocabulary and optional extension validation only; producer-wide emission and reference integrity remain open

criteria.criterion: Every blocking rule has prerequisites, applicability, scope, rationale, limitations and positive/negative/unavailable cases
criteria.reason: Managed blocker inventory and eight typed positive/negative/unavailable cases are enforced. Exhaustive bounded upstream-family case coverage and per-rule applicability counts remain pending.

criteria.criterion: Missing tools, corrupt reports, stale inputs, unsupported syntax and disabled checks never look verified clean
criteria.reason: Native projection/reference checks, explicit producer states, imported-input snapshot checks and SARIF/ESLint malformed-report regressions pass. Legacy envelopes, every upstream payload/fault combination and cross-artifact generation/source integrity are not yet certified.

criteria.criterion: CLI, JSON, SARIF and policy agree on finding identity, evidence and disposition
criteria.reason: Core real-CLI equivalence and lossless native-finding SARIF properties pass; complete end-to-end producer/profile coverage (including all imported/package scenarios) remains pending.

criteria.criterion: Required verification failure cannot be suppressed as an ordinary finding

evidence.result: 77 tests pass on both clean Linux runtime profiles; all five required native channels and required SARIF/configured runtime/coverage remain non-passing without findings. Actual compiler/test/SARIF suppression probes and CLI formats preserve failures.
evidence.scope: Non-waivable verification policy for declared required channels, including missing outputs and empty/suppressed findings; comprehensive payload authenticity/freshness stays E3

criteria.criterion: Overlapping engines preserve corroboration, disagreement and exclusion scope
criteria.reason: Cleanup states and explicit fallback/parallel relationships survive audit/SARIF without inflating blockers. Broader engine scope/exclusion and mutation coverage remains pending.

criteria.criterion: Behavior, unnecessary surface, duplication, escape hatches, locality and leverage have native evidence and limitations

evidence.result: Native measurement and idiom suites pass; reuse/surface are separate and proxy rankings remain advisory
evidence.scope: Availability of native observations with declared limitations, not calibrated ranking or complete behavior proof

criteria.criterion: Declared module/dynamic/public boundary support matrix is tested; unsupported scope is explicit
Runtime and comparison evidence validates source, producer, environment, scope and uncertainty
Change review compares compatible finding snapshots, not only changed hunks
Held-out independently reviewed labels demonstrate useful heuristic ranking under thresholds fixed before tuning
criteria.reason: Independent labels and review have not been supplied; agent-authored regression partitions are not independent validation.

criteria.criterion: Anti-gaming examples exercise their target rules, including needed complexity and removal of required behavior
Before/after refactor pairs have executed behavior-preservation evidence and human-reviewed intent
criteria.reason: Human intent review remains required; executable pairs can be prepared without asserting that review occurred.

criteria.criterion: Per-rule accuracy, applicability, abstention, runtime, memory and mutation stability are reported without labeling unlabeled findings
No redundant parsing for the same capability in one unchanged run
Unrequested expensive capabilities remain unevaluated and do not launch tools
criteria.reason: Focused contexts and editor test permissions have regressions, but every optional producer/tool has not been certified demand-driven.

criteria.criterion: Repeated representative cold/warm resource budgets pass and imposed limits appear in completeness evidence
criteria.reason: Three synthetic repetitions pass the declared ceilings; representative real-project workloads and comprehensive imposed-limit completeness are still missing.

criteria.criterion: Adapters contain no independent analysis policy; critical JSON is validated at typed boundaries
Analysis permissions distinguish executing tests, builds, macros and other project commands
Publication fault injection proves readers reject mixed generations and retain a usable prior generation
criteria.reason: Caught audit publication faults roll back; recovery failure retains backups and blocks cooperating readers/writers. No immutable multi-read generation pin, power-loss/fsync guarantee or universal external-reader transaction has been demonstrated.

criteria.criterion: Timeout and cancellation terminate subprocess trees and publish incomplete rather than clean evidence
